metadata.title: Records and Retention

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing the lifecycle, retention, legal hold, and defensible disposal of institutional data and records.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Records management systems, retention policy engines, archival platforms, and secure destruction mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Constraint pattern governing retention periods, legal holds, archival treatment, and secure disposal of data.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Records and retention apply to data with defined ownership, authority, and scope.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Classification informs retention duration, archival protection, and disposal requirements.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Permitted uses influence whether data must be retained as a record of action or decision.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Records management and retention align with NIST SP 800-53 controls for media protection, contingency planning, planning, and auditability.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Retention of audit and activity records aligns with NIST SP 800-92 guidance on log management.

metadata.remarks: Records and Retention defines enforceable requirements for how long institutional data must be retained, when legal or policy holds apply, and how data is defensibly disposed of when no longer required. This pattern ensures retention decisions are deliberate, reviewable, and aligned with legal, regulatory, and institutional obligations.

components.title: Record Identification and Classification
components.description: Identifies which data assets constitute institutional records and maps them to retention requirements.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Loss or destruction of records due to failure to identify or classify them correctly.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Governance-driven identification prevents premature deletion or unmanaged retention.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Records management plans define which data constitutes official records.

components.title: Retention Period and Legal Hold Management
components.description: Enforces retention schedules and applies legal or policy holds where required.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized deletion of data subject to legal or policy holds.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle governance enforces retention schedules and hold conditions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Retention and hold requirements prevent unauthorized destruction of records.

components.title: Archival Storage and Preservation
components.description: Manages long-term preservation of records requiring extended retention.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Inaccessibility or corruption of archival data through improper storage or degradation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Controlled archival storage preserves availability and integrity over time.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Archived records are preserved and recoverable for required retention periods.

components.title: Defensible Disposal and Destruction
components.description: Ensures records and data are securely destroyed when retention obligations expire.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Residual data exposure due to improper or incomplete destruction.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Verified destruction processes ensure data cannot be recovered.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Media and data are sanitized or destroyed in accordance with retention policy.
